crossings.breakeven_definition: crossing loss at which the worst-path difference equals 2 U, U = 0.20 dB (planning ASSUMPTION)
crossings.layout: adjacent-swap interleave before each stage and inverse swaps after it

errors.note: Uncalibrated; same error model and seeds per (N, correlation) for both architectures.

path_loss.model: worst-path insertion loss = stages x stage loss + crossings x crossing loss (+ stages x vertical loss in 3D); crosstalk not modeled
